fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 is asymptotically impossible in its stated quadratic form. For any CVP-realizable q, if integer minimizers at s=1,2 have residual vectors r1,r2 of norm sqrt(R), then u0=2u1-u2 is integral and gives the s=0 residual 2r1-r2, so f(0)<=9R and Delta/R<=8; moreover the proposed target enumeration has no finite target bound.

Proposal 2 specifies neither the bag cover, representations, assignment-to-word map, tag aggregation, nor scaling, so its search is not bounded. Nonabelianity alone does not defeat G13/G15: after tags are assigned to selector columns, the emitted map is linear and remains vulnerable to signed affine combinations, DROP, and additive parity.

Proposal 3 correctly states the Minkowski lower bound for a nonzero algebraic integer, but never establishes the indispensable nonzero-syndrome premise. Field degree is merely amplification of a residual already known to be vulnerable to exact-zero G13/G15/DROP lifts, and the nonlinear graph lift, quartic field, and syndrome map are not frozen.

Proposal 4 confuses detecting cohomology classes with detecting all harmful cocycles. Coboundaries charge noncocycles and periods charge nontrivial classes, but harmful exact cocycles have zero coboundary and zero periods; no quotient anchor or lower bound for exact representatives is supplied, and the complex and harmful-cochain predicate are unspecified.

Proposal 5 gives no explicit recursive matrices or finite glue search. More fundamentally, a conformal Graver decomposition need not preserve harmfulness in an individual component, so large harmful moves do not follow from the proposed Graver-element condition; G5 and G28 already warn that local circuits or unfavorable legal growth can persist under composition.

Proposal 6 cites communication discrepancy without a theorem converting it into a lower bound for unrestricted integral l2 mass. Signed integer cancellations violate the usual distribution/nonnegativity setting, while the transcript factor, overlapping clauses, target, and exact rational Gram are not specified sufficiently to define the proposed shell.

Proposal 7 is structurally vulnerable to affine lifting: an affine combination of complete valid digit-table encodings preserves every linear transition, carry, and CRT row in every base. Repeating windows only repeats anchor cost alongside completeness cost, so it supplies no polynomial ratio; this is the same exact-zero mechanism exhibited by G13, G15, and G19.
evidence: No Generation-35 verifier evidence or implemented factor/target is supplied; all seven items are proposals only. Therefore none has an experimental pass to weigh against its blockers.

The supplied G13 verifier found a constant-cost harmful selector in the affine span of the 16 consistent encodings, annihilating every compatible linear syndrome over multiple primes. G15 then lifted those coefficients through every frozen hierarchy level with exactly zero residual.

G14 is only a finite pair-bag shell pass; it supplies no logarithmic-bag composition theorem. G32 shows that even fully emitted cross-copy degree-three coupling admits additive zero-residual parity at exactly twice the one-copy cost.

G19 found an exact accepting signed flow with two negative coefficients despite complete conservation and query rows. G28 likewise measured adverse growth below legal growth, so neither automata nor recursive composition may assume signed states become expensive.

G33 and G34 show why completeness geometry must be certified before soundness search: the frozen tags were noncospherical, and every proposed positive-definite repair was exactly infeasible. None of the new geometric/tag proposals supplies an analogous fully specified completeness gate.
next_experiment: None is authorized for these candidates. A restart must freeze one explicit finite construction—including all bags or complexes, columns, rows, targets, scales, coefficient bounds, and control—and first audit exact G13/G15, DROP, G19, and additive-parity lifts; Proposal 1 additionally requires a nonquadratic mutation escaping the universal Delta/R<=8 bound.
